notes:
**Choosing a division for a divisional piston is easier.** Instead of a text box that the keyboard could cover, you now pick from a list of the divisions the app knows for the organ you are on — its divisions, its stops, its piston banks, and any division you have already used in the piece. Anything missing can still be typed with "Type a division…", which opens a box that stays above the keyboard.

This update also includes everything in 2.25 (the Memory Level Catalogue additions and the stray-stamp fix). If you use two tablets together, update both.
